name: byjustinwu
description: Justin Wu (@byjustinwu) Waterloo-engineering video journals, measured from three long uploads and one launch short. Talking-head cold open with no music, music-led b-roll carried by silent lowercase narration captions, long unhurried talk with raw jump cuts and no music under it, loud music-only montages, glitch-collage chapter cards with lowercase date stamps, full-frame vertically stretched slam text, brand card to close.

provenance.source: measured: style study of iK5xtVEnSvU, UhPZ4HeJQ6c, 36ssmIOLffw (pooled) and phS28hhJSP8 (typography only)
provenance.bundle: byjustinwu style-study data bundle extracted 2026-09-24 (yt-dlp 2026.08.19, ffmpeg 7.1.5); not committed
provenance.evidence_conventions: Keys are dotted paths in this profile. 'measured' is a dotted key in study/measured.json, recomputed by study/analyze.py; without 'adjusted' the value must match it within 5%. Evidence cites video_id@seconds or a stat. Confidence: 0.8+ seen consistently in every applicable video; 0.5-0.8 consistent but few instances or one video differs; under 0.5 inferred, coarse or contradicted. Keys this profile inherits from base unchanged carry no entry.

format.frame_rate.evidence: UhPZ4HeJQ6c and 36ssmIOLffw are 24000/1001; iK5xtVEnSvU is 30 fps. follow_footage (base: true) keeps the footage rate when there is one

structure.tolerance_seconds.evidence: interpretation: a diary length is loose, but 30 s keeps a brief's target honest

structure.order.evidence: no video opens on a title (first graphic 0-12.8 s into footage); talk or b-roll open, chapters of talk then music-led b-roll/montage, chapter cards between chapters (UhPZ4HeJQ6c@172.4, 365.4, 463.7, 873.4, 1074.2), reflective close, brand card. About 3 chapters per 10 min (measured chapters.per_10_min.median 3.146), so three chapter blocks for the 18.5 min target

decisions (top level): runtime judgement calls with an editorial flag for conductor.jev.ask; the loader keeps it and warns that it is not read yet

assumptions: Measured from 3 long vlogs (18.5 min median) and 1 launch short; values pool the long vlogs.

The engine's four cut sections pool finer labels: talking = talking + webcam confessional + vlog; montage = music-only montage + music-led b-roll; intro = the cold open; outro = the last section before the end card.
Music levels are measured as programme loudness and written here as clip gain relative to montage, assuming a mastered track at unity plays near -8 LUFS.
Talking is set to play about 10 LU under montage; the measured gap is about 22 LU (talk -29.8 LUFS) and reads as unnormalised camera audio.
Beat alignment, J/L cuts, text animation curves, exact typefaces and texture sources could not be measured from the bundle; see STYLE.md.

slam_stretch.description: Static vertical stretch for full-frame slam text: tall caps filling the frame, no settle.
